# Expander

Header: `winui/ui/containers/Expander.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/containers/Expander.hpp`.

A header row that shows or hides one piece of content below or above it.

The header is the control's single tab stop. A click on it or Space toggles [expanded()](#expanded). Enter doesn't, since it steps into the [Expander](#uiexpander) when it is a focus scope. While collapsed, the content isn't part of the tree at all. It isn't arranged or drawn, and it is out of the tab order and the automation tree. Opening and closing slide the content out from behind the header, clipped, in 333 ms when opening and 167 ms when closing. The control's own height changes at once. [set_content()](#set_content) takes ownership of the content and returns a non-owning observer.

Example: 
```cpp
// Declarative:
ui::Property<bool> open{false};
window.set_content(ui::Expander{
    .header             = "Advanced options",
    .expanded           = open,
    .vertical_alignment = ui::Alignment::Leading,
    .content            = ui::VerticalStack{
        .spacing  = 8,
        .content  = {
            ui::CheckBox{.text = "Verbose logging"},
            ui::CheckBox{.text = "Keep temporary files"},
        },
    },
});

// Imperative:
auto  stack    = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto* expander = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ExpanderControl>("Details"));
expander->set_content(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Shown while expanded"));
expander->on_expanded_changed([&](bool now) { open = now; });
expander->set_expanded(true); // fires the handler
```

## `ui::Expander`

A collapsible header over one child. Builds a [ui::ExpanderControl](#uiexpandercontrol).

[`.expanded = prop`](#uiexpander-expanded) is two-way, which keeps the state in a model. When the user expands or collapses it, the property is written before [`on_expanded_changed`](#uiexpander-on_expanded_changed) runs.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool> open{false};

window.set_content(ui::Expander{
    .header             = "Advanced options",
    .expanded           = open,
    .vertical_alignment = ui::Alignment::Leading,
    .content            = ui::VerticalStack{.spacing = 8, .content = {
        ui::CheckBox{.text = "Verbose logging"},
        ui::CheckBox{.text = "Experimental renderer"},
    }},
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::Expander{
    .header, .expanded, .expand_direction, .content_padding, .style, .margin, .width, .height,
    .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_expanded_changed,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control, .header_content, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uiexpander-header"></span>`header` | `ui::Binding<std::string>` |  | The header text. See [`header_content`](#uiexpander-header_content) for richer headers. |
| <span id="uiexpander-expanded"></span>`expanded` | `ui::TwoWayField<bool>` | `{false}` | Whether the content shows. |
| <span id="uiexpander-expand_direction"></span>`expand_direction` | `ui::Binding<ui::ExpandDirection>` | `{ui::ExpandDirection::Down}` | Down, the default, puts the content below the header, and Up above it. |
| <span id="uiexpander-content_padding"></span>`content_padding` | `ui::Binding<ui::Thickness>` | `{ui::Thickness{16.0f}}` | The inset around the content inside the open content area, 16 DIPs by default ([ui::ExpanderControl::set_content_padding()](#set_content_padding)). |
| <span id="uiexpander-on_expanded_changed"></span>`on_expanded_changed` | `ui::Callback<void(bool)>` |  | Fires with the new state when a header click or Space changes it. A write to the bound property doesn't run it. |
| <span id="uiexpander-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uiexpander-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uiexpander-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uiexpander-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uiexpander-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uiexpander-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uiexpander-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::Expander>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uiexpander-header_content"></span>`header_content` | `ui::Spec` |  | Header content in place of the [`header`](#uiexpander-header) text ([ui::ExpanderControl::set_header_content()](#set_header_content)). |
| <span id="uiexpander-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | The collapsible content. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `enabled`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

### ExpanderControl

```cpp
ExpanderControl()
```

A collapsed [Expander](#uiexpander) with an empty text header and no content.

### ExpanderControl

```cpp
ExpanderControl(std::string header, bool expanded = false)
```

An [Expander](#uiexpander) with [`header`](#header) as its text header, starting expanded or collapsed as [`expanded`](#expanded) says. Doesn't fire [on_expanded_changed()](#on_expanded_changed).

### header

```cpp
const std::string& header() const
```

The header text, drawn in the header row unless [header_content()](#header_content) replaces it.

### set_header

```cpp
void set_header(std::string header)
```

Changes the header text. Updates layout.

### set_header_content

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* set_header_content(std::unique_ptr<T> content)
```

Sets any element as header content, drawn in the header row in place of the text and sized like it. The row stretches it, so the element's own alignment places it within the row. It is part of the header button, so it gets no input of its own, and a click on it toggles the [Expander](#uiexpander). nullptr goes back to the text header. Returns a non-owning observer.

### header_content

```cpp
Element* header_content() const
```

The header content set with [set_header_content()](#set_header_content), or nullptr for a text header. Owned by the [Expander](#uiexpander).

### expand_direction

```cpp
ExpandDirection expand_direction() const
```

Which side the content opens on. Up puts the content above the header, rounds the header's bottom corners only while open, slides the content up from behind the header and turns the chevron around.

### set_expand_direction

```cpp
void set_expand_direction(ExpandDirection direction)
```

Changes the direction. Updates layout.

### set_content

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* set_content(std::unique_ptr<T> content)
```

Takes ownership of the collapsible content and returns a non-owning observer, like [ScrollControl::set_child()](scroll.md#set_child). Replaces and destroys any previous content. nullptr clears it.

### content

```cpp
Element* content() const
```

The collapsible content, or nullptr before [set_content()](#set_content). Owned by the [Expander](#uiexpander).

### expanded

```cpp
bool expanded() const
```

Whether the content region is open or opening.

### set_expanded

```cpp
void set_expanded(bool expanded)
```

Opens or closes the content region and starts the slide. Fires [on_expanded_changed()](#on_expanded_changed) when the value changes. Updates layout.

### on_expanded_changed

```cpp
void on_expanded_changed(Callback<void(bool)> handler)
```

Fired whenever [`expanded`](#expanded) changes, through a header click, Space or [set_expanded()](#set_expanded).

### content_padding

```cpp
const Thickness& content_padding() const
```

The inset between the edges of the open content area and the content inside it, 16 DIPs by default. A dense list inside an [Expander](#uiexpander), such as a navigation pane, needs far less room than card-like content does.

### set_content_padding

```cpp
void set_content_padding(Thickness padding)
```

Changes the content padding. Updates layout.

### header_bounds

```cpp
const Rect& header_bounds() const
```

The header row's own rect from the most recent [arrange()](../tree/element.md#arrange), for hit-testing the header.

### content_bounds

```cpp
const Rect& content_bounds() const
```

The clipped area the content slides into, from the most recent [arrange()](../tree/element.md#arrange). Zero height while fully collapsed.

### slide_progress

```cpp
float slide_progress() const
```

How far the content is through the opening or closing slide, eased. 0 is fully hidden behind the header and 1 fully in place. Read it like [FlyoutControl::transition_opacity()](../controls/flyout.md#transition_opacity).

The slide runs only in a host that ticks the control, such as [ui::run()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#run)'s frame loop. Until the first tick, every [set_expanded()](#set_expanded) jumps straight to the end value, so the content never stays stuck halfway behind the header.

### focused

```cpp
bool focused() const
```

Whether the header has focus. The header itself is the focusable element. The focusable elements inside [content()](#content) join the tab order only while expanded (see [collect_focusables()](#collect_focusables)).

### focusable

```cpp
bool focusable() const override
```

The header is focusable while the [Expander](#uiexpander) is enabled.

### takes_focus_at

```cpp
bool takes_focus_at(Point p) const override
```

Only a press on the header row focuses the [Expander](#uiexpander). Presses on the content don't.


The header, then the focusable elements inside the content while the content region exists and the [Expander](#uiexpander) isn't a focus scope.

### is_pressed

```cpp
bool is_pressed() const
```

Whether the header is drawn pressed, because the pointer is down on it or Space is held.

### for_each_child

```cpp
void for_each_child(ChildVisitor visit) const override
```

Visits the content, but only while the content region exists. A collapsed [Expander](#uiexpander)'s content is skipped by walks over the tree, as it is for layout, rendering and input.


Exposed to UI Automation as a group.

The header text names the [Expander](#uiexpander) when [accessibility()](../tree/element.md#accessibility).name doesn't.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

The header row's height plus, while the content region exists, the content's desired height and the content padding.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Splits the bounds into the header row and the content area, as [expand_direction()](#expand_direction) says, and places the content at its current slide offset.

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

A click on the header row toggles [expanded()](#expanded). A press reaches the content only inside the area it is drawn in ([content_bounds()](#content_bounds)). Moves and releases always reach it.

### hit_test_children

```cpp
void hit_test_children(Point p, std::vector<Element*>& out) const override
```

The children `p` (in this element's layout coordinates) is tested against, topmost first. Default: what [for_each_child()](#for_each_child) lists, last first. A container that draws in another order ([Panel](panel.md#uipanel)'s z-index), a control with parts [for_each_child()](#for_each_child) does not list, or one whose parts cover others in places (a pane drawn over the content) lists them here.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the header row and chevron, the content clipped to its area, then the focus ring.

### clear_dirty_override

```cpp
void clear_dirty_override(DirtyFlags flags) override
```

Clears the dirty flags of this control, of the content while it exists and of the header content.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Advances the open/close slide, then ticks the content while it exists.

### collect_scope_focusables

```cpp
void collect_scope_focusables(std::vector<Element*>& out) override
```

As a focus scope ([Element::set_focus_scope()](../tree/element.md#set_focus_scope), off by default), the content leaves the window's tab order and gets a tab order of its own inside the [Expander](#uiexpander). [Tab](../controls/tabs.md#uitab) reaches the header, Enter steps into the content and Escape steps back out onto the header. Space toggles either way, so the keyboard can always collapse the group from its header.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp
void focus_changed(bool focused) override
```

Called by [Window](../tree/window.md) as focus reaches or leaves the header. Redraws.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

Space toggles [expanded()](#expanded) on key up. Enter does nothing here.

### focus_ring_rect

```cpp
Rect focus_ring_rect(const Theme&) const override
```

The focus ring goes around the header only.

### focus_ring_corner_radius

```cpp
float focus_ring_corner_radius(const Theme&) const override
```

The ring's corner radius: the theme's control radius by default.

## Enumerations

### ExpandDirection

```cpp
enum class ExpandDirection
```

Which way an [Expander](#uiexpander) opens.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Down` | The default. The content opens below the header. |
| `Up` | The content opens above the header, which stays at the bottom. |
